# pvecli pool

Manage resource pools.

| Command | What it does |
|:--|:--|
| [`add`](add.md) | Create one or more resource pools. |
| [`remove`](remove.md) | Delete one or more resource pools. |
| [`content`](content.md) | Manage pool members (VMs/CTs). |
| [`export`](export.md) | Export all pools to a JSON file. |
| [`import`](import.md) | Import pools from a JSON file. |
| [`list`](list.md) | List all resource pools. |
| [`usage`](usage.md) | Show aggregated CPU, memory and provisioned disk usage for a pool. |
| [`info`](info.md) | Show detailed information about a pool. |
